system_prompt:
You are the GOV.UK assistant. You help citizens use government services. Keep replies short.
You do not know in advance which service journeys exist. Search for them when the citizen may want to do something a government service could handle. Do not search for general information questions.
Search results are candidates, not matches. Judge each one yourself, even if only one is returned. Then:
- if one journey fits, name it and offer to start it, but do not start it until the citizen agrees;
- if several could fit, or you need more information, ask the citizen or let them choose;
- if none fits, say you have not found a suitable service.
If the citizen's answer settles which journey they need, choose from the candidates you already have rather than searching again.

events.text: I've lost my armed forces veterans badge. How do I get a new one?

input.query: replace lost armed forces veterans badge

candidates.title: Apply for or replace an armed forces veterans badge
candidates.description: Apply for a first or replacement armed forces veterans badge, either for yourself or for a deceased serviceperson if you receive a War Widow or Widower's Pension or SGIP. Collects service details, such as force and service number, and a UK or overseas postal address.

candidates.title: Give feedback on GOV.UK: Get a digital HM Armed Forces Veteran Card
candidates.description: Give feedback on the Get a digital HM Armed Forces Veteran Card service by rating your satisfaction, suggesting improvements and optionally leaving an email address. It is for feedback only, not for reporting technical faults or for the Apply for a Veteran Card service.

candidates.title: Report a technical issue on GOV.UK: Apply for an HM Armed Forces Veteran Card
candidates.description: Report a problem with the Apply for an HM Armed Forces Veteran Card service, such as an error while uploading a photograph. Describe what you were doing and what happened, and optionally give an email address for follow-up. It is not for feedback or the digital card service.

candidates.title: Report a technical issue on GOV.UK: Get a digital HM Armed Forces Veteran Card
candidates.description: Report a problem with the Get a digital HM Armed Forces Veteran Card service, describing what you were doing, what happened and any error messages. An email address is optional, for follow-up contact. Not for the paper card application or for general feedback.

candidates.title: Give feedback on GOV.UK: Apply for an HM Armed Forces Veteran Card
candidates.description: Give feedback on the Apply for an HM Armed Forces Veteran Card service by rating your satisfaction and optionally suggesting improvements and leaving an email address. It is not for reporting technical faults, which has a separate form.

events.text:
I found a service that fits: **Apply for or replace an armed forces veterans badge**. You use it to apply for a first badge or a replacement. You'll be asked for your service details, such as your force and service number, and a UK or overseas postal address.

Would you like me to start it?
I was diving near Plymouth yesterday and spotted an octopus!

input.query: report an octopus sighting while diving

candidates.title: Octopus sighting? Let us know!
candidates.description: Report an octopus sighting to the Marine Management Organisation, for divers, recreational fishers and the public. Give the date and location, species (common, curled/horned or unknown), optional details and photos, and optional contact details.

candidates.title: Contact HSE about testing and monitoring
candidates.description: Make an enquiry to HSE about its testing and monitoring services, such as explosive atmospheres, diving equipment, fire safety or proficiency testing. Collects contact details, the specific test or service of interest, enquiry details, and organisation industry and size.

candidates.title: Report a concern about a Poisons Act substance
candidates.description: Report a concern about a person or business in connection with a substance defined in the Poisons Act, such as explosives precursors. Give details of who and where they are and what worries you; your own contact details are optional. Sent to the Home Office Chemical Reporting Team.

candidates.title: Report a suspected designated person
candidates.description: Report to OFSI your knowledge or suspicion that a person or organisation is a designated person subject to financial sanctions, giving their Consolidated List group ID, your reasons and identifying details. Use a separate form for each person; frozen assets and suspected breaches have their own reports.

candidates.title: Immigration Enforcement – first reporting event: Middlesborough
candidates.description: Provide personal, household, health, work and identity details before a first immigration reporting appointment at Middlesborough Reporting Centre, using a CEPR or UAN. Also lets you say whether you want voluntary return help and upload passport or ID.

events.text:
I found a service that fits: **"Octopus sighting? Let us know!"** It's a Marine Management Organisation form for divers and others to report octopus sightings. You'd give the date, the location, and the species (common, curled/horned or unknown). You can also add photos, other details and your contact details if you want to.

Do you want me to start it?
I need to change something on my redundancy claim.

input.query: change details on my redundancy claim

candidates.title: Amend my claim for unpaid wages
candidates.description: Amend an existing redundancy claim for unpaid wages made to the Insolvency Service. Confirm your identity with your claim reference and National Insurance number, then give corrected details of wages owed, unpaid dates, net or gross amounts and any attachment of earnings.

candidates.title: Amend my employment details
candidates.description: Amend employment details on an existing redundancy claim: gross weekly pay, employment start and end dates, and the date notice was given. Verify your identity with your claim reference and National Insurance number. Personal details are changed using a separate form.

candidates.title: Amend my personal details
candidates.description: Amend personal details on an existing redundancy payment claim, such as name, National Insurance number, date of birth, email, home address or mobile number. Verify identity with the claim reference and current details; employment details are covered by a separate form.

candidates.title: Amend my claim for holiday taken but not paid
candidates.description: Amend an existing redundancy claim for holidays taken but not paid, changing the holiday year start date, leave entitlement in days, or dates of unpaid holiday. Verify identity with your claim reference and National Insurance number first.

candidates.title: Amend my claim for holiday pay accrued
candidates.description: Amend an existing redundancy claim for accrued holiday pay by correcting the leave year start date, days entitled, days taken and days carried over. Verify identity with claim reference and National Insurance number. Does not cover holiday taken but not paid.

events.text:
Several options could fit. What do you want to change on your redundancy claim?

- **Personal details**: name, National Insurance number, date of birth, email, address or mobile number
- **Employment details**: weekly pay, start and end dates, or the date notice was given
- **Unpaid wages**
- **Holiday taken but not paid**
- **Accrued holiday pay**

Tell me which one and I can start that form.
It's holiday I took but was never paid for.

That's the "Amend my claim for holiday taken but not paid" form. You can use it to change the holiday year start date, your leave entitlement in days, or the dates of the unpaid holiday. You'll need your claim reference and National Insurance number to verify who you are.

Do you want me to start it?
I run a small building firm and I think our timber suppliers are secretly agreeing prices.

input.query: report suspected price fixing or cartel between suppliers

candidates.title: Report a cartel to the CMA
candidates.description: Report suspected cartels or other competition concerns to the CMA, including abuse of market power and bribery, fraud or corruption affecting competition. Give details of the issue, businesses involved and UK nation affected, and optionally upload up to four evidence files, with or without your contact details.

candidates.title: Oil Price Cap (OPC) suspected breach reporting form
candidates.description: Report a suspected breach of the Russia oil price cap to OFSI, either as a final report or a pre-notification. Collects details of the reporter, suspected breachers, oil transaction, voyage, vessel and sanctions evasion red flags, with optional evidence uploads.

candidates.title: How to report a suspected breach of sanctions
candidates.description: Work out which body to report a suspected UK sanctions breach to, by answering questions on financial, trade, Oil Price Cap, trade services, aircraft or shipping, and director disqualification sanctions. It directs you elsewhere rather than taking the report, and also collects technical problem comments.

candidates.title: Financial sanctions suspected breach reporting form
candidates.description: Report a suspected breach of UK financial sanctions to OFSI, either as a self-report or for a third party. Collects details of up to three suspected breachers, the sanctions regime, transaction values, trust services, licence breaches, and supporting documents.

candidates.title: Report a food crime
candidates.description: Report a suspected food crime to the Food Standards Agency's National Food Crime Unit, giving details of the businesses and people involved, how and when it happens, and optional files. Reports can be anonymous, and you can choose whether to share them with a local authority.

events.text:
The "Report a cartel to the CMA" service looks like the right one. You can use it to report suspected price-fixing or other competition concerns to the Competition and Markets Authority. You describe the issue and the businesses involved, and you can upload up to four evidence files. You can include your contact details or leave them out.

I need to renew my passport.

candidates.title: EU Alignment – Plant Passport EOI
candidates.description: Register interest in additional 2026 growing season inspections for EU Plant Passport alignment, if you are already authorised to issue UK Plant Passports. Collects business and contact details, agreement to the EU alignment declaration, and which listed plants you grow or want to move to Northern Ireland or Ireland.

candidates.title: New starter
candidates.description: Request a building security pass for a new starter at Welsh Government offices or tenant organisations. Collects the starter's name, start date, organisation, optional HRIS reference and vetting clearance details, and an uploaded passport-style photo.

candidates.title: Request to restore and renew a registration (TM13)
candidates.description: Request restoration and renewal of a lapsed UK trade mark whose renewal date was 6 to 12 months ago. Give the trade mark number, classes to renew and a statement explaining the missed renewal, then pay the restoration and renewal fees by card or deposit account.

candidates.title: Immigration Enforcement – first reporting event: Middlesborough
candidates.description: Provide personal, household, health, work and identity details before a first immigration reporting appointment at Middlesborough Reporting Centre, using a CEPR or UAN. Also lets you say whether you want voluntary return help and upload passport or ID.

candidates.title: Expression of interest to become authorised to issue Plant Passports
candidates.description: Register interest in becoming authorised to issue UK Plant Passports. Collects the business trading name, head office address, the person responsible for plant passporting, contact phone and email, and an optional APHA customer reference number.

input.query: apply for or renew a UK adult British passport

candidates.title: Report a change of contact details for a settled adult
candidates.description: Report a change of mobile number or email address for an adult in a resettled family, on behalf of a local authority. Only for people in the 3-year Afghan scheme or 5-year UK Resettlement Scheme support period, and it needs your region's referral code.

candidates.title: Apply for an emergency travel document (first time applicant)
candidates.description: Apply for an emergency travel document from abroad if you have never held a UK passport issued since 1 January 2006 and have an urgent, unplanned reason to travel. Collects applicant and contact details, location and a summary of exceptional circumstances, for yourself or someone else.

candidates.title: Expression of interest to become authorised to issue Plant Passports
candidates.description: Register interest in becoming authorised to issue UK Plant Passports. Collects the business trading name, head office address, the person responsible for plant passporting, contact phone and email, and an optional APHA customer reference number.

candidates.title: EU Alignment – Plant Passport EOI
candidates.description: Register interest in additional 2026 growing season inspections for EU Plant Passport alignment, if you are already authorised to issue UK Plant Passports. Collects business and contact details, agreement to the EU alignment declaration, and which listed plants you grow or want to move to Northern Ireland or Ireland.

candidates.title: Request to restore and renew a registration (TM13)
candidates.description: Request restoration and renewal of a lapsed UK trade mark whose renewal date was 6 to 12 months ago. Give the trade mark number, classes to renew and a statement explaining the missed renewal, then pay the restoration and renewal fees by card or deposit account.

candidates.title: Get help with your citizenship or certificate of entitlement application
candidates.description: Contact the Home Office for help with a British citizenship application, certificate of entitlement application or renunciation of citizenship, such as updates, refunds, returns of documents or certificate corrections. Can be completed on behalf of someone else, with a letter of authority.

candidates.title: Apply to renew your authorisation to provide Driver CPC part 3a tests
candidates.description: Renew DVSA authorisation to provide Driver CPC part 3a tests, as the organisation's responsible person. Collects organisation and contact details, plus the assessor's photo, examiner number, driving licence number, licence points and work site addresses.

candidates.title: Apply to renew annual Northern Ireland plant health label (NIPHL) scheme authorisation
candidates.description: Renew an existing annual Northern Ireland plant health label (NIPHL) scheme authorisation. Collects business and contact details, the authorisation number, and declarations for any plants for planting, used agricultural and forestry machinery, or seed potatoes already authorised. Not for first-time applications.

candidates.title: Register for an account
candidates.description: Register an account for yourself if you are aged 16 or over, giving your name, date of birth, address, phone number and National Insurance number, plus a Welsh language contact preference. One form per person; under-16s need a separate child account form.

candidates.title: Feedback on the Great British Insulation Scheme (GBIS)
candidates.description: Give feedback on the Great British Insulation Scheme (GBIS) portal by rating your satisfaction from very satisfied to very dissatisfied, and optionally suggest how the scheme could be improved. Collects no payment or personal details.

events.text:
I couldn't find a service for renewing a standard UK passport. The catalogue I can search doesn't include it.

The closest match was an emergency travel document for first-time applicants abroad. That doesn't fit a renewal, so I haven't suggested it.

Passport renewals are normally done on the official GOV.UK passport service. Search GOV.UK for "renew adult passport" to find it.

If you're abroad and urgently need to travel, tell me. I can look for emergency options.
What's the FCDO travel advice for Spain?

I can't look up travel advice here, and it changes often. The current FCDO advice for Spain is on GOV.UK at **gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/spain**. It covers entry requirements, safety and security, health, and local laws.

I can also help you find a government form to complete, if you need one.
